result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may assign without consent to an Affiliate or qualifying M&A successor; Licensor assignments require Licensee consent, not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed, and cannot be made to a Licensee competitor; and Licensee’s Change of Control creates no termination right. Unrelated license-transfer restrictions are generally preserved. However, the revision goes beyond the stated position by prohibiting suspension, repricing, or other modification following a Change of Control and by adding notice obligations. Drafting also needs cleanup: the retained sentence voiding transfers made “without such consent” is potentially ambiguous as applied to expressly consent-free assignments, and “this Section Subject” is missing punctuation.
